environment: Local PGlite with production reviewer/parent table definitions; synthetic Auth/record/provider adapters. No production mutations.
limits: Does not prove production schema erasure, global stale-JWT denial, device cleanup, provider delivery, backup policy or legal retention.
checks: Default-off release gate, private privileges, account binding, idempotent queue and phase checks
Expired workers are fenced; actual reviewer/parent capability cleanup preserves child, other guardian and unrelated reviewer
Storage lost acknowledgements retain durable manifests, apply backoff and block records/Auth/completion
Retry completes only after all phases; completion removes manifest paths and subject linkage while preserving unrelated synthetic records
Schema drift blocks automatic processing without discarding the request or deadline
A foreign-account media manifest is rejected atomically before any object removal
Notification failure stays pending after Auth removal; retry resumes confirmation without repeating completed phases
Missing stale-token revocation proof blocks erasure; this checks the gate, not production JWT coverage
Residual personal data prevents completion and confirmation even after Auth deletion
Bounded work yields safely; pause prevents new claims; worker functions are invokers and missing adapters cannot run
SDK contracts use exact Storage API objects and hard Auth deletion; ambiguous/forbidden responses never count as absence
